info.description: Larynth control-plane API v1. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable type URI per code (x-larynth-error-codes). Operations carry x-larynth-min-role, x-larynth-auth, x-larynth-scope, x-larynth-idempotency and x-larynth-sdk.

keep_echo_words.description: Count caller words that repeat the agent's own reply (line echo) as barge-in words

vad_only_min_speech_ms.description: Barge-in on voice activity alone, before the STT has heard a word, needs this much speech. Unset is 1000

status.description: ready once every source is indexed; failed carries error

mode.description: lexical when the knowledge base has no vectors or the query embedding was unavailable

force_finalize.description: Ask the STT provider to end its turn when the turn is committed on a non-STT signal. Unset uses the engine node default

short_first_chunk.description: Cut the first TTS chunk early and send it as its own utterance for a faster first audio. Unset uses the engine node default

speculative_tts.description: Synthesise the first chunk of a speculative reply privately and play it only if the turn is committed. Unset uses the engine node default

speculative_tts_min_prob.description: Minimum eager end-of-turn probability for speculative TTS. Unset uses the engine node default
